webster.text: Not congruous; unsuitable; not fitting; inconsistent; improper.

example.quote: Had this been the case, surely it would have been highly incongruous.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. IREDELL, July 29, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
